sun.title: Sun Gemstones
sun.about: The Sun, known as Surya in Vedic astrology, represents vitality, confidence, individuality, leadership, recognition, and inner strength. Sun-associated gemstones are traditionally chosen to support qualities connected with self-expression, courage, purpose, and personal presence. Different gemstones may be considered depending on an individual's birth details, horoscope, Rashi, Nakshatra, and planetary influences. Each stone has its own colour, character, and traditional significance. A personalized consultation can help determine which gemstone is most appropriate for an individual.

aboutList.name: Note
aboutList.desc: Ruby (Manik) has the strongest traditional astrological association with the Sun. The suitability of any gemstone should be considered based on individual astrological factors.

stones.name: Ruby (Manik)
stones.subtitle: Principal Gemstone of the Sun
stones.description: Ruby, traditionally known as Manik or Manikya, is the principal gemstone associated with the Sun in Vedic astrology. Its vibrant red colour and natural brilliance have long been connected symbolically with confidence, leadership, vitality, individuality, and personal strength.

stones.name: Sunstone
stones.subtitle: The Stone of Optimism & Vitality
stones.description: Sunstone is admired for its warm golden, orange, and reddish tones and its attractive natural shimmer. In traditional crystal practices, it is associated with optimism, confidence, motivation, vitality, and positive self-expression.

stones.name: Red Spinel
stones.subtitle: The Stone of Courage & Strength
stones.description: Red Spinel is a naturally occurring gemstone with rich red tones and a brilliant appearance. While it is not as traditionally established as Ruby for the Sun in Vedic astrology, Red Spinel is sometimes considered an alternative or associated stone because of its colour and symbolic connection with vitality, courage, confidence, and strength.

moon-chandra.title: Moon (Chandra) Gemstones
moon-chandra.about: The Moon, known as Chandra in Vedic astrology, is traditionally associated with the mind, emotions, intuition, calmness, sensitivity, nurturing qualities, and inner peace. Moon-associated gemstones are valued for their soft colours, soothing appearance, and symbolic connection with lunar energy. Pearl (Moti) is traditionally regarded as the principal gemstone of the Moon. Moonstone, White Agate, and White Coral may also be considered in certain spiritual and gemstone traditions. The right gemstone may vary according to an individual's Birth Details, Rashi, Nakshatra, and planetary influences.

aboutList.name: Traditional Association
aboutList.desc: Associated with lunar qualities in some traditions

aboutList.name: Note
aboutList.desc: Pearl (Moti) has the strongest traditional Vedic astrological association with the Moon. The suitability of Moonstone, White Agate, or White Coral should be considered according to individual astrological factors.

stones.name: Pearl (Moti)
stones.subtitle: Principal Gemstone of the Moon
stones.description: Pearl, traditionally known as Moti, is the principal gemstone associated with the Moon in Vedic astrology. Its natural lustre and soft white appearance have long been symbolically connected with calmness, emotional balance, intuition, nurturing energy, and inner harmony.

stones.name: Moonstone
stones.subtitle: The Stone of Intuition
stones.description: Moonstone is admired for its milky appearance and characteristic luminous sheen. In traditional crystal practices, it is associated with intuition, emotional awareness, calmness, feminine energy, and spiritual reflection.

stones.name: White Agate
stones.subtitle: The Stone of Harmony
stones.description: White Agate is valued for its soft, elegant appearance and natural patterns. In traditional crystal practices, it is associated with harmony, emotional balance, calmness, stability, and a peaceful mindset.

stones.name: White Coral
stones.subtitle: The Stone of Purity
stones.description: White Coral is an organic gemstone material traditionally valued for its smooth appearance and soft white colour. In some gemstone and spiritual traditions, White Coral is associated with purity, peace, emotional balance, and spiritual awareness.

mars-mangal.title: Mars (Mangal) Gemstones
mars-mangal.about: Mars, known as Mangal in Vedic astrology, is traditionally associated with courage, determination, physical energy, action, confidence, and initiative. Mars-associated gemstones are valued for their vibrant red and orange colours and their symbolic connection with strength and motivation. Red Coral (Moonga) is traditionally regarded as the principal gemstone associated with Mars. Carnelian and Red Jasper are also appreciated in crystal and spiritual traditions for qualities such as courage, grounding, vitality, and determination. The appropriate gemstone may vary according to an individual's Birth Details, Rashi, Nakshatra, and planetary influences.

aboutList.name: Note
aboutList.desc: Red Coral (Moonga) has the strongest traditional Vedic astrological association with Mars. Carnelian and Red Jasper are better presented as associated or alternative stones rather than direct astrological equivalents. Gemstone suitability should be considered according to individual astrological factors.

stones.name: Red Coral (Moonga)
stones.subtitle: Principal Gemstone of Mars
stones.description: Red Coral, traditionally known as Moonga, is the principal gemstone associated with Mars in Vedic astrology. Its natural red colour and organic origin give it a distinctive appearance, while traditional gemstone practices associate it with courage, confidence, determination, initiative, and personal strength.

stones.name: Carnelian
stones.subtitle: The Stone of Motivation
stones.description: Carnelian is a warm orange to reddish-orange variety of chalcedony, admired for its vibrant colour and natural translucency. In traditional crystal practices, Carnelian is associated with motivation, courage, creativity, confidence, and taking purposeful action.

stones.name: Red Jasper
stones.subtitle: The Stone of Grounding
stones.description: Red Jasper is a naturally occurring opaque gemstone known for its earthy red colour and distinctive natural patterns. In traditional crystal practices, it is associated with grounding, stability, courage, determination, and emotional balance.

mercury.title: Mercury (Budha) Gemstones
mercury.about: Mercury, known as Budha in Vedic astrology, is traditionally associated with communication, intellect, learning, and adaptability. Mercury-associated gemstones are valued for their clarity and vibrant green hues.

aboutList.name: Note
aboutList.desc: Emerald (Panna) has the strongest traditional Vedic astrological association with Mercury. Green Tourmaline and Peridot are better presented as associated or alternative stones rather than direct astrological equivalents. Gemstone suitability should be considered according to individual astrological factors.

stones.name: Emerald (Panna)
stones.subtitle: Principal Gemstone of Mercury
stones.description: Emerald, traditionally known as Panna, is the principal gemstone associated with Mercury in Vedic astrology. Its rich green colour and natural brilliance have long been admired, while traditional gemstone practices associate it with communication, intellect, learning, clarity, and confidence in self-expression.

stones.name: Green Tourmaline
stones.subtitle: The Stone of Creativity
stones.description: Green Tourmaline is admired for its beautiful range of natural green shades and distinctive crystalline appearance. In traditional crystal practices, it is associated with emotional balance, creativity, clarity, positive communication, and personal growth.

stones.name: Peridot
stones.subtitle: The Stone of Renewal
stones.description: Peridot is a naturally occurring gemstone known for its fresh green to yellowish-green colour and bright appearance. In traditional crystal practices, it is associated with positivity, clarity, emotional balance, confidence, and renewal.

jupiter-guru.title: Jupiter (Guru) Gemstones
jupiter-guru.about: Jupiter, known as Guru or Brihaspati in Vedic astrology, is traditionally associated with wisdom, knowledge, learning, prosperity, guidance, spirituality, and personal growth. Jupiter-associated gemstones are valued for their warm yellow and golden tones and their symbolic connection with knowledge and abundance. Yellow Sapphire (Pukhraj) is traditionally regarded as the principal gemstone associated with Jupiter. Yellow Tourmaline and Lapis Lazuli may also be considered in broader gemstone and spiritual traditions for qualities associated with wisdom, clarity, confidence, and spiritual development. The appropriate gemstone may vary according to an individual's Birth Details, Rashi, Nakshatra, and planetary influences.

aboutList.desc: Associated with wisdom and spiritual qualities

stones.name: Yellow Sapphire (Pukhraj)
stones.subtitle: Principal Gemstone of Jupiter
stones.description: Yellow Sapphire, traditionally known as Pukhraj, is the principal gemstone associated with Jupiter in Vedic astrology. Its bright yellow to golden colour and natural brilliance have long been admired, while traditional gemstone practices associate it with wisdom, knowledge, prosperity, confidence, learning, and spiritual growth.

stones.name: Yellow Tourmaline
stones.subtitle: The Stone of Optimism
stones.description: Yellow Tourmaline is a naturally occurring variety of Tourmaline admired for its warm yellow to golden shades. In gemstone and crystal traditions, it is associated with confidence, optimism, creativity, personal growth, and positive energy.

stones.name: Lapis Lazuli
stones.subtitle: The Stone of Inner Truth
stones.description: Lapis Lazuli is a deep blue gemstone traditionally valued for its rich colour and natural golden inclusions. In spiritual and crystal traditions, it is associated with wisdom, self-awareness, inner truth, learning, communication, and spiritual reflection.

venus-shukra.title: Venus (Shukra) Gemstones
venus-shukra.about: Venus, known as Shukra in Vedic astrology, is traditionally associated with love, relationships, beauty, creativity, luxury, harmony, refinement, and appreciation of art. Venus-associated gemstones are admired for their brilliant appearance and are symbolically connected with elegance, attraction, harmony, and creative expression. White Sapphire is traditionally regarded as the principal gemstone associated with Venus. Opal and Colorless Zircon are also valued for their beauty and are considered associated or alternative stones in various gemstone traditions. The appropriate gemstone may vary according to an individual's Birth Details, Rashi, Nakshatra, and planetary influences.

aboutList.name: Note
aboutList.desc: White Sapphire has a strong traditional association with Venus in Vedic gemstone practices. Opal and Colorless Zircon are better presented as associated or alternative stones rather than direct astrological equivalents. Gemstone suitability should be considered according to individual astrological factors.

stones.name: White Sapphire
stones.subtitle: Principal Gemstone of Venus
stones.description: White Sapphire is a naturally occurring colourless variety of Sapphire known for its clarity, brilliance, and elegant appearance. In traditional Vedic gemstone practices, it is associated with Venus and symbolically represents harmony, refinement, creativity, relationships, and appreciation of beauty.

stones.name: Opal
stones.subtitle: The Stone of Emotional Expression
stones.description: Opal is admired for its distinctive play-of-colour, which can display beautiful flashes of multiple colours depending on the stone and lighting. In traditional gemstone and spiritual practices, Opal is associated with creativity, emotional expression, relationships, beauty, and positive self-expression.

stones.name: Colorless Zircon
stones.subtitle: The Stone of Elegance
stones.description: Colorless Zircon is a naturally occurring gemstone known for its brilliance, transparency, and attractive sparkle. It is sometimes considered an alternative Venus-associated gemstone and is valued symbolically for elegance, confidence, harmony, and appreciation of beauty.

saturn-shani.title: Saturn (Shani) Gemstones
saturn-shani.about: Saturn, known as Shani in Vedic astrology, is traditionally associated with discipline, patience, responsibility, perseverance, structure, and long-term growth. Saturn-associated gemstones are often valued for their deep blue and violet shades and their symbolic connection with stability, focus, and inner strength. Blue Sapphire (Neelam) is traditionally regarded as the principal gemstone associated with Saturn. Lapis Lazuli and Amethyst are also appreciated in spiritual and crystal traditions for qualities such as grounding, clarity, reflection, and emotional balance. The appropriate gemstone may vary according to an individual's Birth Details, Rashi, Nakshatra, and planetary influences.

aboutList.name: Note
aboutList.desc: Blue Sapphire (Neelam) has the strongest traditional Vedic astrological association with Saturn. Lapis Lazuli and Amethyst are better presented as associated or alternative stones rather than direct astrological equivalents. Gemstone suitability should be considered according to individual astrological factors.

stones.name: Blue Sapphire (Neelam)
stones.subtitle: Principal Gemstone of Saturn
stones.description: Blue Sapphire, traditionally known as Neelam, is the principal gemstone associated with Saturn in Vedic astrology. Its deep blue colour and exceptional brilliance have made it one of the most significant gemstones in traditional astrological practices, where it is symbolically associated with discipline, focus, responsibility, perseverance, and stability.

stones.name: Lapis Lazuli
stones.subtitle: The Stone of Wisdom
stones.description: Lapis Lazuli is a deep blue gemstone admired for its rich colour and distinctive natural golden inclusions. In spiritual and crystal traditions, it is associated with wisdom, self-awareness, clarity, inner reflection, and spiritual growth.

stones.name: Amethyst
stones.subtitle: The Stone of Calmness
stones.description: Amethyst is a violet to purple variety of quartz valued for its distinctive colour and natural clarity. In traditional crystal practices, it is associated with calmness, focus, spiritual awareness, inner reflection, and emotional balance.

rahu.title: Rahu Gemstones
rahu.about: Rahu is traditionally regarded as a shadow planet in Vedic astrology and is associated with ambition, worldly experiences, unconventional thinking, transformation, desire, and new opportunities. Rahu-associated gemstones are often valued for their distinctive colours and symbolic connection with determination, adaptability, and navigating change. Hessonite Garnet (Gomed) is traditionally regarded as the principal gemstone associated with Rahu. Orange Zircon and Spessartite Garnet may be presented as associated or alternative stones in broader gemstone and spiritual traditions. The appropriate gemstone may vary according to an individual's Birth Details, Rashi, Nakshatra, and planetary influences.

aboutList.name: Note
aboutList.desc: Hessonite Garnet (Gomed) has the strongest traditional Vedic astrological association with Rahu. Orange Zircon and Spessartite Garnet are better presented as associated or alternative stones rather than direct astrological equivalents. Gemstone suitability should be considered according to individual astrological factors.

stones.name: Hessonite Garnet (Gomed)
stones.subtitle: Principal Gemstone of Rahu
stones.description: Hessonite Garnet, traditionally known as Gomed, is the principal gemstone associated with Rahu in Vedic astrology. It is known for its distinctive honey, golden-orange, and reddish-brown shades and is traditionally associated with clarity, confidence, focus, determination, and navigating periods of change.

stones.name: Orange Zircon
stones.subtitle: The Stone of Creativity
stones.description: Orange Zircon is a naturally occurring gemstone admired for its warm orange to golden-orange colour and brilliant appearance. In gemstone and spiritual traditions, it can be associated symbolically with confidence, creativity, motivation, positive energy, and personal expression.

stones.name: Spessartite Garnet
stones.subtitle: The Stone of Motivation
stones.description: Spessartite Garnet is a vibrant orange to reddish-orange variety of Garnet known for its warm colour and natural brilliance. In crystal and gemstone traditions, it is associated with creativity, confidence, motivation, courage, and an energetic approach to personal growth.

ketu.title: Ketu Gemstones
ketu.about: Ketu is traditionally regarded as a shadow planet in Vedic astrology and is associated with spirituality, intuition, detachment, introspection, and inner transformation. Ketu-associated gemstones are often valued for their distinctive appearance and symbolic connection with spiritual awareness, focus, and self-discovery. Cat's Eye (Lehsunia) is traditionally regarded as the principal gemstone associated with Ketu. Tiger's Eye and Quartz Cat's Eye may be presented as associated or alternative stones in broader gemstone and spiritual traditions. The appropriate gemstone may vary according to an individual's Birth Details, Rashi, Nakshatra, and planetary influences.

aboutList.name: Note
aboutList.desc: Cat's Eye (Lehsunia) has the strongest traditional Vedic astrological association with Ketu. Tiger's Eye and Quartz Cat's Eye are better presented as associated or alternative stones rather than direct astrological equivalents. Gemstone suitability should be considered according to individual astrological factors.

stones.name: Cat's Eye (Lehsunia)
stones.subtitle: Principal Gemstone of Ketu
stones.description: Cat's Eye, traditionally known as Lehsunia or Vaidurya, is the principal gemstone associated with Ketu in Vedic astrology. Its distinctive chatoyant band creates a striking eye-like effect across the surface of the stone. In traditional gemstone practices, it is symbolically associated with intuition, spiritual awareness, focus, protection, and introspection.

stones.name: Tiger's Eye
stones.subtitle: The Stone of Courage
stones.description: Tiger's Eye is a golden-brown gemstone known for its distinctive silky chatoyancy and bands of light. In traditional crystal practices, it is associated with courage, grounding, confidence, focus, and balanced decision-making.

stones.name: Quartz Cat's Eye
stones.subtitle: The Stone of Clarity
stones.description: Quartz Cat's Eye is a variety of quartz displaying a characteristic cat's-eye effect caused by aligned internal inclusions. Its distinctive appearance makes it a popular gemstone for spiritual and decorative purposes, while crystal traditions associate it with focus, intuition, clarity, and inner awareness.
